up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows that have a non‑null pChEMBL value for the human single‑protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1929 (Xanthine dehydrogenase/oxidase; Homo sapiens, tax_id 9606). For each row return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order the rows by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1929' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
